description: Card B2's 600: a 599 cc four, redline 16,000.

targets.name: Starts and runs
targets.source: a warm engine started on its key runs (engine.state 2)

targets.name: Within full scale
targets.source: 02-contracts.md, section 1: what process writes is within +-1

targets.name: Holds the limiter
targets.source: a fuel-cut or ignition-cut rev limiter holds the speed within a few percent of where it cuts

targets.name: Peak torque
targets.source: a 600 supersport four makes 62 to 68 N m at about 11,000 rpm (makers' claims). Reported, not failed: a miss until the engine's breathing and friction at high piston speed are right (card B2's handoff).

targets.name: Peak power
targets.source: a 600 supersport four makes about 88 to 92 kW at 14,500 rpm (makers' claims, e.g. the R6's 87.1 kW). Reported, not failed: as above.
